units.source_text: 这信写在白色薄纸上，非常工整，然而并无特殊风趣。

en.t: The letter was written on thin white paper and was very neatly composed, yet it had no particular charm.

units.source_text: 笔迹倒也很优秀，可见此人富有才能。

en.t: The handwriting itself was quite fine, showing that this man was richly talented.

units.source_text: 玉鬘全不把他放在心上，即使他夜夜不来，亦无所谓。

en.t: Tamakazura did not care about him at all, and even if he failed to come night after night, it made no difference to her.

units.source_text: 这封战战兢兢的信，她看也不看，当然置之不复。

en.t: She did not even look at this timid, trembling letter, and of course she left it unanswered.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将等不到回信，十分伤心，忧愁了一整天。

en.t: General Higekuro waited in vain for a reply, was deeply hurt, and spent the entire day in sorrow.
